currentIndexOwner: Project Manifest artifacts.voiceBibleVersion (no second source of truth)
semanticFingerprintRule: whole document minus {voiceBibleId, version, provenance.createdAt, provenance.source, provenance.approvalRef, fingerprint}, PLUS provenance.rights and provenance.evidenceRefs
rationale: timestamps/approval refs must not fake a version bump; a rights or evidence change must never be silently dropped
noFakeBumpOnReplay: same semantic content → revise returns changed:false, deduped:true and writes nothing (V5)
meaningfulChangeNewVersion: voiceId / provider / model / language / speedDefault / persona tone / prohibited delivery pattern / pronunciationProfileRef / rights → new voiceBibleId + version+1 (V6)
